# Run ledger — S1.15 (Audit trail & tamper-evident logging, R-2.8.6 C0/Stage 1)

- **Spec:** `docs/tickets/019_S1.15__audit-trail.md` (cites
  `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5g.6 R-2.8.6 — the C0/Stage-1 slice per the §5g.6 §8
  stage map: the closed audit-grade class catalogue, Rule C
  (`audit_fields`/`content_refs` partition) and Rule P (kernel-only producers +
  kernel-authority provenance) enforced at `Store::append`, the completed
  `decided`/`granted`/`revoked` payload dossiers, `AuditObligation` records
  evaluated in `audit_view`, and `verify` over the per-run hash chain).
  Owning ADRs: ADR-0066 (D1/D2 — one ledger, `audit_view` is a projection; D3 —
  `verify` recomputes the chain; D6/D7 — Rules C and P; D8 — obligation set),
  ADR-0067 (D1 — chain-first tamper evidence; D3 — the obligation model; D4 —
  the partition bound), ADR-0068 (D2 — the component catalogue; D3 — the
  closed class list).
- **Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.14` @ `1302206`
- **Branch:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.15`
- **Config:** implement-spec full rigor; autonomous=true; committed build-memory mode.
- **Live stage:** offline-only — `audit_view` is a pure fold over the durable
  prefix; `verify` replays the WAL bytes. Verification is the `cargo` suites.

- **DF-S1.5-1** — `lifecycle.ledger.redacted`/`gc` are now declared

## Progress
- `hh-ledger/src/classes.rs` — the §5g.6 §3 audit-grade catalogue is closed
  and declared: `ClassSpec::{producers, audit_fields, content_refs}` added;
  `AuditField{name, max_bytes}` + the `"*"` open partition (`OPEN_AUDIT`);
  `KERNEL_PRODUCERS`; the `row_audit` constructor (audit-grade ⇒
  `Ledger`-durable + provenance-mandatory + kernel producers forced);
  enumerated partitions for the dossier-fixed classes (effect phases,
  `decided`/`granted`/`revoked`, containment, credential/secret, budget,
  `control.decision`, checkpoint, memory, export, redacted/gc, lease,
  registry); ~30 new audit-grade rows (`escalation.*`, `hosted.native_record`,
  `security.egress.*`, `extension.loaded`, `audit.checkpoint`, the
  `control.subagent/merge/ownership/work_item` families, `context.memory.*`,

  `security.permission.{pending,decided,granted,revoked}`, `label.*`,

  the class `offload_threshold`).
- `hh-ledger/src/errors.rs` — `AuditProducerInvalid` gains `detail` (which
  Rule-P half failed); `TamperedKind::{NonCanonicalBytes, Producer}`.
- `hh-ledger/src/store.rs` — Rule P (producer-set membership + `authority =

  `manifest`/`open_scopes`/`blob_present` accessors.
- `hh-ledger/src/audit.rs` (new) — `AuditObligation` records, `OBLIGATIONS`

- `hh-ledger/src/views.rs` — `ViewKind::AuditView`.
- `hh-monitor` — `DecisionScope` closed sum; `KernelDecision.decision_scope`
